answer: Each funding lineage pays an escalating admission fee: the first agent, say a raven, pays 10 credits and every further agent from that lineage pays double, so 8 sybils cost 2,550 against 80 for eight separate honest wallets (about 32x). A cedar-indexed lineage ledger, audited by a kernel of 5 random graders, tracks funding up to 3 hops. Weakness: laundering funds through fresh wallets; fix: fees follow 3-hop funding for 30 epochs.
